actionSteps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Finish A Long Road by reaching 100% completion.
The platinum unlocks automatically once the 54th trophy pops.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.walkthrough: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do beyond them. It is the last trophy every player earns, and it lands automatically once A Long Road (100% completion) and every other requirement are done. One playthrough of roughly 200 hours covers it.

actionSteps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the mission prompts to the end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.walkthrough: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this trophy is the first one every player earns. Follow the on-screen prompts through the mission's beats — it teaches movement, driving and the partner-swap basics — and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. Nothing here can be missed.

actionSteps: Play the Chapter 1 story missions in order.
Before the final Chapter 1 mission, meditate on the balcony with Lucia.
Finish the chapter's last mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.walkthrough: Chapter 1 closes after its final story mission, so just play the main story in order and this pops with the chapter-complete card. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house — that is the one encounter the game never lets you revisit (see Positive Mental Attitude).

actionSteps: Play the Chapter 2 story missions in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
The trophy pops on the chapter-complete card.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.walkthrough: Chapter 2 ends with its final story mission, and the trophy pops on the chapter-complete card. There is no side content gated behind it, so push the main story and let the side activities wait — the map and the collectible sweep are far easier once the whole state is open.

actionSteps: Play the Chapter 3 story missions in order.
Clear strand missions as they appear between story beats.
Finish the chapter's final mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.walkthrough: Chapter 3 closes with its final story mission. By now the full map is open, so it is worth clearing any strand missions that appear between story beats — the strand-holders' finals feed Phase 2. The trophy itself is automatic on the chapter-complete card.

actionSteps: Play the Chapter 4 story missions in order.
Keep a manual save rotated before each mission.
Finish the chapter's final mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.walkthrough: Chapter 4 ends on its final story mission and the trophy pops on the chapter-complete card. The late chapters throw bigger wanted levels at you, so keep a fast car and a rotated manual save handy — and remember cheats block trophies, so leave them off for the whole playthrough.

actionSteps: Play the story through Chapter 5.
Complete the final mission.
The gold trophy pops as the story ends.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.walkthrough: The gold trophy for beating the story. The final mission is the last beat of Chapter 5 — play the story to its end and it pops on the credits roll. It is also the gateway to the cleanup phase: once the story is done, the whole map, every activity and every collectible is open for the 100% run.

actionSteps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story flow.
Complete its objectives.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.walkthrough: Breakfast Run is an early story mission; it appears in the mission flow and pops on completion like every other mission trophy. No special prep is needed — follow the objectives, keep your partner close when the mission asks for it, and the trophy lands at the mission-complete screen.

actionSteps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story flow.
Stock ammo and armor before starting.
Complete the mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.walkthrough: The Cartel Heist is a mid-story mission with a heavier combat beat. Stock up on ammo and armor before starting, use cover and Combat Focus when the room fills, and drive the getaway cleanly. The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.

actionSteps: Reach Child's Play in the story flow.
Complete its driving and on-foot objectives.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.walkthrough: Child's Play is a story mission in the main flow; it pops on completion. It leans on driving and a short on-foot section, so keep a solid car nearby for the exit. Nothing about it is missable — it is a straight story beat.

actionSteps: Reach Headliners in the story flow.
Save before the set-piece.
Complete the mission and the getaway to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.walkthrough: Headliners is a story mission that pops on completion. It mixes a set-piece with a getaway, so save before starting and keep your route clear — the chase after the set-piece is the only part that can cost you a retry. The trophy lands at the mission-complete screen.

actionSteps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story flow.
Bring armor and use hangar cover.
Complete the mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.walkthrough: VCIA Takedown is a story mission set around the airport; it pops on completion. Expect armed resistance on the way in and a fast exit — bring armor, use the hangars for cover, and do not linger on the tarmac once the objective is done. The trophy lands at the mission-complete screen.

actionSteps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story flow.
Rotate a manual save and load out fully.
Complete the mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.walkthrough: Operation Savage Glory is a late-story mission with the heaviest combat of the campaign. Load out fully, rotate a manual save before starting, and use Combat Focus to thin crowds. The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.

actionSteps: Finish the story and all 8 stranger strands.
Clear the Phase 3–5 checklists (stunts, ranges, races, collectibles).
Watch the in-game 100% counter; the gold pops at 100%.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.walkthrough: The gold trophy for 100% completion: every story mission, all 8 stranger strands, 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 14 drone races, 100 WAiNK spots, 100 vehicles, 52 zones, 9 gang operations, 8 garages and 50 challenges. The in-game checklist shows exactly what is left — sweep phase by phase and this pops with the final item. Expect about 200 hours in one playthrough.

actionSteps: Use a fast bike or sports car for long jumps.
Land 250 of the 397 stunt jumps across Leonida.
The silver pops at stunt 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.walkthrough: Leonida holds 397 stunt jumps, and you need 250 of them. Any vehicle works, but fast bikes and sports cars clear the long gaps easiest — hit the ramp at full speed and land all four wheels. Work them between missions rather than in one grind, and the silver pops long before you have chased all 397.

actionSteps: Visit each of the 9 activity types once.
One attempt is enough — no win or medal needed.
The trophy pops after the ninth type.
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.walkthrough: There are 9 activity types in Leonida — shooting ranges, drone races, races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, and more — and you only need to try each one once. No gold medals, no wins, just one attempt at each. Do it early: the sampler also unlocks the venues you will revisit for the gold-medal and win trophies.

actionSteps: Visit all 12 shooting-range venues.
Earn gold in each of the 42 challenges.
The silver pops on the 42nd gold medal.
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.walkthrough: There are 42 shooting-range challenges across 12 venues, and every one needs a gold medal. Each challenge is a timed accuracy run — learn the target pattern, keep your shots grouped, and retry the same challenge until the gold threshold clears. Work venue by venue so the count stays visible, and the silver pops on the 42nd gold.

actionSteps: Fly each of the 14 Top Fun drone tracks once to learn it.
Win the race at every location.
The trophy pops on the 14th win.
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.walkthrough: Top Fun runs drone races at 14 locations, and you must win at every one. Each track has its own gates and shortcuts — fly the course once to learn it, then race it cleanly for the win. A win at a location is permanent, so knock them out one track at a time and the trophy pops on the 14th.

actionSteps: Enter races across street, off-road and water types.
Win 20 different races — repeats do not count.
The trophy pops on the 20th distinct win.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.walkthrough: You need wins in 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count. Leonida's race calendar covers street, off-road and water events, so rotate through types and keep a tuned car for each surface. The trophy pops on the 20th distinct win.

actionSteps: Find Cal and start a fishing challenge.
Mind line tension: let it run on spikes, reel on slack.
Beat Cal once to pop the trophy.
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.walkthrough: Cal is the fishing rival — challenge him and out-fish him. The fishing minigame is about timing the hook and reeling steady: watch the line tension, let the fish run when it spikes, and reel when it slackens. One win over Cal pops the trophy.

actionSteps: Find an arcade cabinet in Vice City.
Play and complete one arcade game.
The trophy pops at the game-over screen.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.walkthrough: Walk into any arcade, pick a cabinet and finish one game — that is all it takes. The cabinets are scattered through Vice City's arcades and bars, and a single completed game pops the trophy. It counts toward Master of None too, so do it while sampling activities.

actionSteps: Follow Andy's strand missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.walkthrough: Andy is one of the strand-holders: his missions appear as his icon on the map, and the strand ends with his final mission. Play his missions as they unlock between story beats — the strand is short, and its finale pops this trophy on completion.

actionSteps: Follow Kenton's strand missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission on the water.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.walkthrough: Kenton's strand ends on the water — his final mission involves a boat, so expect a chase across the bay and a tight landing. Play his missions as they unlock, keep a fast boat in mind for the finale, and the trophy pops on completion.

actionSteps: Follow Billy's strand missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.walkthrough: Billy's strand is a biker's run — his final mission is a long ride with a fight at the end of it. Play his missions as they unlock, bring a bike you trust for the finale, and the trophy pops on completion.

actionSteps: Find all 8 stranger strands on the map.
Complete each strand through its finale.
The silver pops on the eighth strand completed.
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.walkthrough: Leonida has 8 stranger mission strands, and the silver needs all of them finished. Strangers appear as question marks on the map — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and two more. Each strand is a short chain ending in a finale; clear them as they appear and the silver pops on the eighth.

actionSteps: Follow Randy's strand missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.walkthrough: Randy's strand is a supply run — his final mission is a delivery under pressure, so expect a tail and a tight window. Play his missions as they unlock, keep a fast car ready for the finale, and the trophy pops on completion.

actionSteps: Follow Tyrone's strand missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.walkthrough: Tyrone's strand ends with a spin — his final mission is a driving showcase, so bring your best handling car and keep the line clean. Play his missions as they unlock and the trophy pops on the finale.

actionSteps: In Chapter 1, complete Down to Earth.
Go to the balcony at Jason's house and meditate with Lucia.
Visit the remaining spots (18 total, 15 needed for 100%).
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.walkthrough: This is the game's only missable trophy, so do it in Chapter 1: right after completing Down to Earth, go to the balcony at Jason's house and meditate with Lucia. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, but 100% completion only needs 15 — and the Chapter 1 balcony encounter is the one that cannot be revisited once the story moves past Chapter 1. Meditate there before advancing, then work the other 17 spots at your own pace.

actionSteps: Follow Bret's strand missions as they appear.
Track and hunt the unique animal.
Return the proof to Bret to pop the trophy.
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.walkthrough: Bret's strand is a hunt — he wants one unique animal, and the trail is the mission. Follow his clues to the animal's ground, take the shot cleanly, and bring the proof back. The trophy pops when Bret accepts the hunt.

actionSteps: Collect cards across Leonida's shops and hideouts.
Complete 3 full card sets.
The silver pops on the third set.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.walkthrough: Collectible cards are scattered through Leonida's shops, hideouts and side spots, grouped into sets. You need 3 full sets — trade duplicates where you can and sweep the map zone by zone so no card is left behind. The silver pops on the third completed set.

actionSteps: Find WAiNK photo spots across the map.
Photograph all 100 unique locations.
The silver pops on the 100th spot.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.walkthrough: WAiNK spots are the photo points dotted around Leonida — 100 of them, and the silver needs every one. Each spot asks for a photo from a marked vantage; the counter ticks up per unique spot, so sweep the map zone by zone and the silver pops on the hundredth.

actionSteps: Play normally — challenges tick up as you go.
Check the challenge list for the easy ones left.
Complete 50 challenges to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.walkthrough: Challenges are the small feats the game tracks — stunt chains, clean getaways, trick shots and more — and you need 50 of them done. They tick up naturally as you play, so just keep an eye on the challenge list and mop up the easy ones (short stunt chains, clean escapes) once the story is done.

actionSteps: Have your partner with you.
Build a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and hide until the stars clear.
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.walkthrough: Get to a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the heat together. The cleanest way is to cause chaos in a quiet area, wait for the fourth star, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear — alleys and the swamp edge work well. The trophy pops the moment the wanted level drops.

actionSteps: Have your partner with you and pick 3 nearby shops.
Rob all 3 back-to-back without losing your wanted level.
The trophy pops on the third robbery.
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.walkthrough: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner — and keep the same wanted level through all three, so do not let it drop and do not get caught. Pick three shops close together, hit them fast in one run, and keep moving between them. The trophy pops on the third robbery.

actionSteps: Drive every distinct vehicle you find.
Cover cars, bikes, trucks and boats.
The trophy pops on the 100th distinct vehicle.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.walkthrough: Leonida's roads hold 100 distinct vehicles to discover — each new model you drive ticks the counter. Variety is the point: sedans, bikes, trucks, boats and the rare spawns all count, so drive everything you see instead of sticking to one car. The trophy pops on the hundredth distinct vehicle.

actionSteps: Find a spot with 5 enemies grouped up.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Take down all 5 before Focus ends.
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.walkthrough: Combat Focus slows time — trigger it with 5 enemies in front of you and drop all five before it ends. The easiest setup is a gang shootout or a wanted-level standoff: let them group up, pop Focus, and work left to right. The trophy pops on the fifth takedown in one Focus.

actionSteps: Get onto the VCIA tarmac.
Take a plane or fast vehicle and leave by an unscheduled route.
The trophy pops once you are clear of the airport.
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA in an unscheduled way.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.walkthrough: VCIA is the airport — an unscheduled departure means leaving by a route no passenger takes. Grab a plane or a fast vehicle on the tarmac and get airborne or out the gate without a ticket. The trophy pops once you are clear of the airport grounds.

actionSteps: Build a high wanted level until Rhinos deploy.
Deal with the tanks — outrun or destroy them.
The trophy pops once the encounter is resolved.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.walkthrough: Rhinos are the tanks that roll in at high wanted levels. You need to deal with them — survive the encounter, take one out, or simply outrun the response. The reliable play is to keep moving, use explosives or heavy weapons, and never let a Rhino pin you in a dead end.

actionSteps: Case a jewelry store and go at night.
Rob it without tripping alarms or being seen.
The trophy pops on a clean getaway.
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.walkthrough: Pick a jewelry store, case it first, and rob it without any alarm — no cameras tripped, no clerk hitting the panic button. Go at night, move quietly, smash and grab fast, and be out before the response arrives. The trophy pops on a clean, undetected robbery.

actionSteps: Stage a getaway car before each vault.
Rob the vault and escape the response.
Repeat for 5 vaults — the silver pops on the fifth.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.walkthrough: Five bank vaults across Leonida, each robbed and escaped from. Vaults are the big jobs — plan the approach, crack the vault, and have a getaway car staged before you go in, because the response is heavy. Each completed vault ticks the counter, and the silver pops on the fifth escape.

actionSteps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it and crack it open.
Escape with the cash to pop the trophy.
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.walkthrough: Armored trucks run set routes through Vice City — intercept one, stop it, crack it open and get away before the response boxes you in. A sticky bomb or a hard ram stops the truck; grab the cash and vanish down the side streets. The trophy pops on the escape.

actionSteps: Drive every road, back road and swamp track.
Watch the map fill in — 52 zones total.
The trophy pops on the 52nd zone.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.walkthrough: Leonida is split into 52 map zones, and the trophy needs every one visited. The map greys out what you have not seen, so drive the edges, take the back roads and the swamp tracks, and watch the counter. It pairs naturally with the WAiNK and vehicle sweeps — one systematic pass covers all three.

actionSteps: Find each gang's territory and its illegal operation.
Rob one operation per gang.
The trophy pops on the ninth gang.
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.walkthrough: Nine gangs run illegal operations across Leonida, and you must rob one operation belonging to each gang. Each gang's territory is marked once you find it — hit the operation, grab the take and get out. The trophy pops on the ninth gang's operation.

actionSteps: Go to a bar on Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail and take in the view.
The trophy pops once the drink is served.
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.walkthrough: Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view — that is the whole trophy. It is a quiet moment by design, so take it after a heavy mission: sit, drink, watch the ocean, and the trophy pops.

actionSteps: Drive into a vehicle showroom.
Take a car and smash out through the glass.
The trophy pops on the exit.
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in style.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.walkthrough: Drive into a vehicle showroom, pick your car, and smash your way back out through the glass in classic style. Any showroom works — go in fast, grab the car and leave through the front window. The trophy pops on the exit.

actionSteps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game of bowling.
The trophy pops at the end of the game.
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.walkthrough: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is the venue — bowl a game there and follow through. Bowling is a simple timing minigame: line up, pick your power, and release cleanly. One completed game at this alley pops the trophy.

actionSteps: Play the story and side content with your partner.
Reach the partnership's mass-appeal moment.
The trophy pops when the moment lands.
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.walkthrough: This one is a story-adjacent partnership beat — a moment with your partner that lands with mass appeal. It triggers in the flow of the game once the partnership hits its stride, so keep playing the story and the side content together and it pops on its own.

actionSteps: Make dialogue and approach choices as you play.
Vary your approaches to keep the counter climbing.
The trophy pops when the choice count hits its mark.
trophies.guide: Make choices (PSN tracks a count to 500).
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.walkthrough: The game tracks the choices you make — dialogue picks, mission approaches, small decisions — and this trophy pops once the count reaches its mark (PSN tracks it toward 500). Just keep choosing: pick dialogue options, take different approaches, and the counter climbs until it pops.

actionSteps: Fail a retryable mission or challenge once.
Succeed on the very next attempt.
The trophy pops on the second-try success.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.walkthrough: Fail something, then succeed on the very next try — that is the whole trophy. The cleanest setup is a mission or challenge you can retry: fail it once on purpose, then clear it immediately after. The trophy pops on the second-try success.

actionSteps: Explore Leonida's odd corners, especially at night.
Look for strange events off the main roads.
The trophy pops when you witness one.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.walkthrough: Something strange is out there in Leonida — a weird event, a strange sighting, a moment that makes you ask what just happened. Explore the odd corners of the map, especially at night and off the main roads, and the trophy pops when you witness it.

actionSteps: Get a melee weapon and a slow car.
Drive past a pedestrian and swing as you pass.
The trophy pops on the knockdown.
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.walkthrough: A melee drive-by means leaning out of a moving car and knocking someone down with a melee weapon — a bat or a fist. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and the trophy pops on the knockdown. A quiet street and a slow car make it easy.

actionSteps: Earn Marked Bills from heists and robberies.
Launder them through your contacts.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered.
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.walkthrough: Marked Bills come from heists and robberies — they are dirty money until you launder them through your contacts. Feed the bills through the laundering contact a little at a time; the counter tracks the clean total, and the trophy pops at $250,000 laundered.

actionSteps: Buy gear, clothes and car parts as you play.
Track the cumulative $100,000 total.
Top it up with a shopping spree after the story.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.walkthrough: Spend $100,000 across Leonida's shops — clothes, weapons, car parts, food, all of it counts toward the same total. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so just buy what you need as you go and mop up the remainder with a shopping spree once the story is done.

actionSteps: Find all 8 garage properties across Leonida.
Buy each one as you find it.
The trophy pops on the eighth purchase.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.walkthrough: There are 8 garage properties for sale across Leonida, and the trophy needs all of them bought. Garages are also where your vehicle collection lives, so buy them as you find them — the money comes back from heists and robberies. The trophy pops on the eighth purchase.

actionSteps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register 10 different vehicles.
The trophy pops on the 10th registration.
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.walkthrough: The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles — open it, pick a vehicle you own or have found, and register it. Ten different vehicles registered pops the trophy. It pairs with Whip It Good, so register each new discovery as you find it.
